breakdown.description: Prandtl number value is inconsistent with the stated fluid (air at 25 C does not have Pr≈7).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify the physical inconsistency. The ground truth correctly states that air at 25 C has a Prandtl number around 0.7, not 7.0. Instead of correcting this value or flagging the inconsistency, the agent proceeded with the calculation using the incorrect Pr=7.0 value provided in the incomplete prompt.
